title: Record the later value of register 360
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 18932, register 360 holds `1/4` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `-1` and contributes `-1/4` to register 354, which is `0` until then.
- Event 16153 adds `1/4` times register 262, which holds `-1`, and takes register 360 from `1/2` to `1/4`. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
